name: KNLMeansCL
description: GPU-accelerated Non-Local Means denoising via OpenCL. Effective on grain, sensor noise, and compression artifacts. Works on SDR and HDR.

params.label: Strength (h)
params.help: Filter strength. Larger values remove more noise but also more detail. The plugin default is 1.2.

params.label: Temporal radius (d)
params.help: Past/future frames used per output frame: total = (2*d+1). Larger usually denoises better but is slower and uses more memory.

params.label: Search window (a)
params.help: Spatial search radius. Each frame is searched in a (2*a+1)^2 px window. Larger = better quality, slower.

params.label: Similarity radius (s)
params.help: Similarity-neighborhood radius: (2*s+1)^2. Performance impact is low — adjust based on noise nature.

params.label: Channels
params.help: Which channels to denoise. 'auto' = Y for YUV sources, RGB for RGB sources.

params.label: Weight mode
params.help: Weighting function. 0 = Welsch (original NLMeans, default). 1/3 = Modified Bisquare (more robust). 2 = Bisquare with hard threshold.

params.label: Reference weight (wref)
params.help: How much of the original pixel to mix back into the result, relative to the most-similar match found.

params.label: OpenCL device type
params.help: OpenCL device class. 'auto' tries accelerator → GPU → CPU.

params.label: OpenCL device ID
params.help: Index of the device of the chosen type (0 = first).
